coll_subtitle: Track cards you own by expansion
home_subtitle: Import from a supported URL or paste a list to get started.
home_import_url_desc: Paste a URL from a supported site. The deck must be public.
home_import_url_unknown: This hostname doesn't match any supported site.
home_import_text_desc: One name per line (with optional quantity).
home_import_text_area:
1 Sol Ring
1 Arcane Signet
1 Command Tower
home_import_extras_url: Also include sideboard, tokens, maybeboard, companion
home_import_extras_url_sub: By default only commander + 99 main. Cost is calculated on the 100.
home_import_extras_text: Include sideboard / maybeboard if marked in the list
home_empty_title: You don't have any decks yet.
home_empty_subtitle: Import one above to get started.
home_unresolved_hint: Common causes: misspelled name, very recent cards not yet indexed by Scryfall, or incorrect set/number codes.
home_unresolved_add_suggestion: Add this card to the deck
stats_curve_hint: Hover a column to see its breakdown.
stats_footer: Counts the included commander and main deck cards. Sideboard and tokens are left out.
landing_hero_sub: Paste a deck URL or a list, pick the art for every card, and export a PDF to print at home or an XML for MakePlayingCards. Everything happens on your computer.
landing_hand_placeholder_note: Sample cards: your commanders take their place as soon as you import a deck.
landing_continue_title: Pick up where you left off
landing_flow_title: Four steps to the cutting mat
landing_flow_1_desc: From a URL or plain text, with commander, sideboard and maybeboard sections.
landing_flow_2_desc: Every line is matched on Scryfall. Lines that fail come back with the original text so you can fix them.
landing_flow_3_desc: Official printings, community MPC Autofill drives or your own images. Filter by full art, borderless, artist or set.
landing_flow_4_desc: A PDF with bleed and cut guides, the MPC Autofill XML, an image ZIP or the decklist as text.
landing_studio_desc: Margins, bleed, per-card or per-page cut guides, rounded corners and duplex with drift compensation.
landing_tool_planner: Group several decks into MakePlayingCards orders and see which price bracket each one lands in.
landing_tool_library: Browse the whole art index without starting from a card: by artist, by set, or full art only.
landing_tool_collection: Mark the cards you already own and cross-check them with your decks to print only what's missing.
landing_tool_calibrate: A two-page test sheet turns “the back comes out crooked” into two exact offsets.
landing_tool_history: Every change lands on a timeline and can be reverted on its own.
landing_status_offline_off: Download the Scryfall dump to work without a connection
landing_status_art_empty: Add a community drive to widen the art picker
landing_local_note: Everything lives on your computer: no account, no server, no telemetry.
nf_heading: This page isn't in the deck
nf_body: The link may be outdated or the address may have a typo. Your decks are right where you left them.
nf_deck_body: This deck is no longer in your library. It may have been deleted.
nf_card_rules: Exile the page {path}. It doesn't return to the battlefield.
nf_card_flavor: “I could have sworn it was here a moment ago.”
deck_pdf_quick: Quick PDF with last Studio settings
deck_xml_autofill: Open with MPC Autofill desktop tool
deck_stats_title: Mana curve, color distribution and types
deck_tokens_title: Tokens the cards generate (included in the PDF)
deck_lang_note: Applies to all cards. Custom art is not touched.
deck_decklist_note: Active cards only · tokens and meld excluded
deck_custom_art_title: Rescan custom art folders for new images
deck_filter_placeholder: Search by name, type or color…
planner_subtitle: Group decks into MPC orders and compare the real cost per card
planner_no_decks: You don't have any decks yet.
planner_keep_together_hint: Orders ship separately; half a deck is unplayable
planner_subtract_hint: Plan only what you still need to print
planner_empty_hint: Pick one or more decks to see how many orders they need and what they would cost.
planner_filler_free_suffix: free filler cards: those slots are already paid for.
planner_price_note: Prices exclude shipping and taxes. Shipping to Europe is usually the bulk of the cost on small orders.
library_subtitle: Browse everything indexed across your drives, without starting from a card
library_no_index: You haven't indexed any drives yet. The library fills up with whatever the indexer finds.
calibration_intro: Two adjustments so cards come out exact: the scale (so they measure 63 × 88 mm) and duplex drift (so the back lands on the front).
calibration_flip_hint: Pick the same one you use for the cards: it determines which axis the back is mirrored on, and getting it wrong flips the sign of the correction.
calibration_print_1: Print double-sided at 100% scale, with no fit-to-page.
calibration_print_2: Use the same paper you'll use for the cards.
calibration_print_3: Hold the sheet up to the light, front side towards you.
calibration_measure_intro: Against the light you'll see two overlapping crosshairs: the front one (solid) and the back one (dashed). Use the millimetre rulers to read how far apart they are.
calibration_sign_hint: Right and up are positive. If the dashed crosshair sits 2 mm to the right, enter 2. If it sits 2 mm to the left, enter -2.
calibration_where_to_apply: Copy these two values into PDF Studio → Duplex → Back offset. They're saved per deck.
calibration_already_aligned: Your printer is already aligned: no correction needed.
calibration_offset_suspicious: A drift over a centimetre isn't normal miscalibration. Check that you measured from the centre and that the paper feeds straight.
calibration_second_pass: To verify, apply the values, print this same sheet again and check whether the crosshairs now line up. If there's still drift, repeat with the new measurement.
picker_drives_capped: This card has more than {total} arts in the drives; showing the {total} most relevant. Use the tag or set filters to narrow it down.
picker_no_arts: No art available for this face.
picker_dedup_hint: Groups art from different drives with the same image.
pdf_picker_no_arts: No art available for this face.
history_empty: You haven't generated any XML or PDF yet.
pdf_no_active_cards: The deck has no active cards.
pdf_mini_picker_no_arts: No art available for this face.
settings_offline_desc: Import Scryfall's full bulk data (~1 GB on disk) so card resolution, adding cards, autocomplete and printing searches are answered locally instead of calling the API. It takes a few minutes and can be cancelled: whatever was imported is kept.
bulk_started_desc: You can keep using the app meanwhile
bulk_cancelled_desc: Whatever was already imported is kept
bulk_done_desc: Cards now resolve without a connection
settings_subtitle: Changes apply instantly and are saved in your data folder.
settings_general_desc: Cardstock, foil, cardback and art preferences applied when opening a deck.
settings_prices_desc: USD → EUR conversion and shipping cost used by the deck estimator.
settings_network_desc: User-Agent, Google Drive API key and SSL bypass option for corporate environments.
settings_no_api_key: No Google API key: only the first level of each drive is indexed.
settings_clear_override: Clear override and revert to default
settings_no_move_warning: Existing files are not moved. Move them manually if you want to keep them.
settings_restart_warning: It is recommended to restart the app after changing paths so that HTTP image URLs are refreshed.
settings_log_none_msg: No active log (nothing written this session yet).
settings_index_pinned: Index the drives you have marked as pinned
settings_index_all: Index all drives (may take several minutes)
storage_desc: Everything MPC Forge keeps on this machine, folder by folder. Art and thumbnails can be rebuilt; the database and your custom art cannot.
storage_disk_app_share: MPC Forge uses {pct} % of this drive
storage_backup_next: The next full backup will take at most {size}; a database-only one, {db}.
storage_backup_none: You have not created any backup yet.
storage_cleanup_desc: Only what can be deleted without losing anything is offered: the database, your custom art and the cardbacks are never touched.
storage_cleanup_nothing: There is nothing to free up.
storage_exports_recent: Keep exports from the last 30 days
storage_backups_keep: Keeps the most recent automatic backup and deletes the older ones.
storage_confirm_exports: Exported files (XML, PDF, ZIP) will be deleted. You can generate them again from each deck. Continue?
storage_confirm_backups: Old automatic backups will be deleted. Backups you created by hand are left alone. Continue?
storage_cat_database_desc: Decks, collection, history and the drive index. The only thing that cannot be recovered from anywhere.
storage_cat_art_desc: Downloaded card images. Deleting them only costs the time to fetch them again.
storage_cat_custom_art_desc: Your own images. They are on no server: delete them and they are gone.
storage_cat_cardbacks_desc: Back face images available in the picker.
storage_cat_thumbs_desc: WebP derived from the art for the grids. Regenerated on the fly.
storage_cat_exports_desc: MPC Autofill XMLs, PDFs and image ZIPs already generated.
storage_cat_backups_desc: The backup .zip files, both automatic and manual.
storage_cat_logs_desc: Debug log for this session and its rotations.
storage_cat_other_desc: Whatever else sits in the data folder and does not fit the other categories.
history_subtitle: Change timeline per deck and print run log.
history_empty_decks: You don't have any decks yet.
js_toast_error_fallback: An unexpected error occurred. Check the console for details.
js_duplicate_prompt:
New deck name:

All cards, roles and custom art will be duplicated.
Moxfield link and history are not copied.
js_delete_deck_confirm:
Delete deck "{name}"?

Cards and art choices will be lost. Downloaded files are NOT deleted.
history_no_decks_yet: You haven't created any decks yet.
history_no_xml_yet: You haven't generated any XML yet.
settings_paths_saved_desc: The app is now using the new paths. Restart to refresh HTTP image URLs.
settings_autofill_desc: When installed, MPC Forge can launch it directly with the generated XML to automatically upload everything to MakePlayingCards.com.
settings_autofill_place_hint: Place the executable in the project folder, in the system PATH, or configure the path below.
settings_backup_desc: Creates a zip with the DB (decks, collection, history, preferences), your own art and cardbacks. The Scryfall catalog and art are left out: they are downloaded again. The 5 most recent manual backups are kept. The zip is saved to your data folder.
settings_ssl_restart_hint: Already-instantiated HTTPX clients won't change without a restart. Close and reopen the app to apply insecure mode.
settings_drives_desc: A curated list of community Google Drives with custom art (like those used by mpcfill.com). Download images from them and add them to your deck.
settings_apikey_ok: API key configured — recursive indexing available.
settings_no_drives: No drives configured. Add one above or click "Restore catalog".
settings_custom_art_desc: You can use your own art (or art downloaded from the community) alongside official Scryfall art. Ways to add it:
settings_no_api_key_warn: No Google API key configured — drive indexing is limited to the first level. Add it in Network & connection for full fuzzy search with subfolders.
settings_restore_confirm: Restore {n} drives from the curated catalog (idempotent)
settings_how_to_use_drives: How to use art downloaded from these drives:
settings_drive_step1: Download the image from the drive (Google Drive → "Download").
settings_drive_step2a: Copy it to %APPDATA%\MPC-Forge\custom_art\ with the exact card name.
settings_drive_step2b: Or in the editor: select the card → + Add by URL with the direct URL.
deck_related_already: Related cards are already in the deck.
deck_preload_title: Preloading alternative art — picker will be instant
deck_confirmdelete_msg:
Remove '{name}' from the deck?

This action cannot be undone.
pdf_no_back_gap: Leaves gap for cards without back
pdf_comment_open_editor: offers an "Open in full editor" button.
proof_subtitle: Full grid at near real size. This is how every XML slot will be printed.
art_upload_drop_here: Drag an image here or click to choose one
art_upload_drop_hint: You can also paste it from the clipboard with Ctrl+V.
art_upload_requirements: PNG, JPG or WEBP · up to 30 MB · ideally 745×1040 px (300 dpi) or more, in the 63×88 mm card ratio
art_upload_drop_on_card: Drop the image to use it as the art for
art_upload_preview_hint: This is how it prints at 63×88 mm
art_upload_fit: The image is not in card proportions
art_upload_fit_crop_desc: Fills the card and trims what sticks out at the sides.
art_upload_fit_contain_desc: Shows the whole image and fills the gap with black.
art_upload_fit_stretch_desc: Uses the image as is; it will look distorted.
art_upload_variant_hint: Helps you tell it apart in the picker. It is saved in your custom art folder.
art_upload_duplicate_msg: The copy you already had for this card is reused.
art_upload_err_unsupported_format: Unsupported format. Use PNG, JPG or WEBP.
art_upload_err_too_large: The image is larger than 30 MB.
art_upload_err_not_an_image: The file is not a valid image or cannot be read.
art_upload_err_too_small: The image is too small: it needs at least 200 px per side.
art_upload_err_too_many_pixels: The image is too large (over 60 megapixels).
art_upload_err_corrupt: The image is damaged or incomplete.
art_upload_check_ratio_stretch: Ratio {ratio} instead of 0.72: it will print distorted
art_upload_check_ratio_crop: It will be cropped to card proportions
art_upload_check_ratio_contain: It will be fitted to card proportions with black borders
art_upload_check_dpi_low: Somewhat low resolution (~{dpi} dpi); 300 is recommended
art_upload_check_dpi_poor: Very low resolution (~{dpi} dpi): it will look pixelated
pdf_drop_hint: Click a card to change its art, or drop an image on it
settings_custom_upload_desc: in any card's art picker press “Upload image”, or drag the image onto the card in the deck editor or in PDF Studio. You get a preview, and the format, resolution and proportions are checked before it is saved.
tour_settings_desc: Watch the welcome tour and each screen's guide again whenever you like. You can also open them from the “Guide” button at the bottom of the sidebar.
tour_settings_auto_desc: Each screen shows its guide the first time you open it.
tour_disabled_msg: You can watch them again from “Guide” in the sidebar or Settings → General.
tour_welcome_intro_body: Turn any decklist into print-ready proxies: pick the art for every card, generate a PDF for your printer or the XML to order them from MakePlayingCards. Here are the essentials in a minute.
tour_welcome_home_body: Your starting point: import a deck by pasting its link, pick up the last one you worked on and check the workshop status.
tour_welcome_decks_body: All your decks in one place. Import them from Moxfield, Archidekt and other sites, or by pasting the list as text.
tour_welcome_collection_body: Mark, set by set, the cards you already own so you know what you don't need to print.
tour_welcome_library_body: Browse all the art available: downloaded from Scryfall, indexed from community drives and your own uploads.
tour_welcome_planner_body: Combine several decks into MPC orders and use the price tiers to pay less per card.
tour_welcome_calibrate_body: Print a test sheet and adjust the margins so fronts and backs line up when you print double-sided at home.
tour_welcome_history_body: A log of what you've printed and every change to your decks, with undo.
tour_welcome_settings_body: Art drives, prices and shipping, offline mode, paths, backups… Index the drives here to get thousands of community arts.
tour_welcome_search_body: Type a card name to see which decks have it, how many copies and with which art.
tour_welcome_lang_body: Switch the interface language at any time.
tour_welcome_replay_title: Come back to this guide any time
tour_welcome_replay_body: From here you can replay the guide for the current screen or the full tutorial. It's also in Settings → General.
tour_welcome_done_body: Every screen has its own mini guide that appears the first time you visit it. Use <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> to move and <kbd>Esc</kbd> to close.
tour_home_import_body: Paste a deck link from Moxfield, Archidekt, MTGGoldfish… and press Import. Press <kbd>/</kbd> at any time to jump to this field.
tour_home_text_body: You can also paste the list as text (for example “1 Sol Ring”) from the Decks page.
tour_home_hand_body: Your latest decks show up as cards in hand. Click one to open it.
tour_home_recent_title: Pick up where you left off
tour_home_recent_body: Shortcuts to the decks you've worked on recently.
tour_home_flow_body: Import, choose the art, review and export: the steps from a list to printed cards.
tour_home_tools_body: Shortcuts to PDF Studio and the other tools: art library, planner, calibration…
tour_home_status_body: At a glance: indexed drives, offline Scryfall data and other things worth checking.
tour_decks_url_body: Paste the URL of a public deck; the app detects the site and fetches the list with its cards.
tour_decks_text_body: Paste a list in the “quantity name” format. If a card isn't recognised you can fix it before the deck is created.
tour_decks_list_body: Each deck shows its commander or cover card. Click to open the editor.
tour_decks_menu_body: Hover a deck to see its menu: rename, duplicate or delete.
tour_deck_title_body: Double-click the name to rename the deck.
tour_deck_cost_body: What ordering the deck from MakePlayingCards would cost, shipping included. If a few more cards would get you a cheaper tier, it tells you here.
tour_deck_stock_body: The card stock and finish used when generating the MPC order.
tour_deck_filters_body: Filter by name, type or colour, change the order, group by role or type and switch between column and list view.
tour_deck_art_body: Click a card to open the picker: every official printing, community drive art and your own. Double-click an art to remember it across all your decks.
tour_deck_upload_body: Use your own image for this card. You can also drag an image onto the row or paste it with Ctrl+V in the picker; you'll see a preview before it's saved.
tour_deck_actions_body: Change the quantity, leave it out of the print, move it to another section (sideboard, tokens…) or remove it.
tour_deck_add_body: Add single cards to the deck by their exact name.
tour_deck_tools_body: Statistics, tokens the deck makes, previous print runs, translation into another language, list export and rescanning your custom art folder.
tour_deck_xml_body: Generate the XML for the MPC Autofill client, which uploads the images and prepares the order for you.
tour_deck_pdf_body: PDF Studio lays the deck out on sheets for your printer or print shop, with cut guides, bleed and backs.
tour_pdf_intro_body: This is where you prepare the PDF: quick settings on the left, the real preview in the middle and every page option on the right.
tour_pdf_presets_body: Start from one: classic MPC, with bleed, double-sided, Silhouette… then tweak whatever you need.
tour_pdf_page_body: Click any card to change its art, or drop an image on it to use your own. What you see is what gets printed.
tour_pdf_settings_body: Paper size, grid, margins, cut guides, bleed, registration marks and page range.
tour_pdf_cardback_body: Choose whether the PDF includes backs (at the end or interleaved for double-sided printing) and pick the deck's card back: from a URL, the drives or by uploading your own image.
tour_pdf_guide_body: A detailed explanation of every option and tips for double-sided printing that lines up.
tour_pdf_build_body: When it looks right, generate the PDF. You can also export a ZIP with one image per card.
tour_proof_intro_body: Every card exactly as it will be printed, so you can review the deck at a glance before exporting.
tour_proof_controls_body: Adjust the card size and also show the backs of double-faced cards.
tour_history_decks_body: Every art, card or quantity change is logged. Expand a deck to see its history and undo changes.
tour_history_runs_body: The runs you've printed or ordered, so you know which art you used and how many copies you have.
tour_collection_stats_body: How many cards you've marked and how many sets you've started.
tour_collection_sets_body: Search a set by name or code and open it to see all its cards.
tour_collection_cards_body: Click the cards you physically own. That way you know which cards in your decks don't need printing.
tour_planner_decks_body: Select the decks you want to order together and the maximum size of each order.
tour_planner_results_body: The planner splits the cards into orders using MPC's price tiers and suggests alternatives.
tour_library_filters_body: Search by card, artist or set and filter by source: Scryfall, community drives or your own art.
tour_library_grid_body: Click an image to see its details and which decks use it.
tour_calibrate_why_body: Every printer shifts the sheet a little. When printing double-sided, a few millimetres are enough for the back not to line up. You fix it once and it stays fixed.
tour_calibrate_steps_body: Print the test sheet, measure the offset with a ruler and apply the correction: it's saved in your PDF settings.
tour_settings_nav_body: Settings are grouped by topic. Pick a section to see its options.
tour_settings_search_body: Type what you're looking for and see the matching options from every section.
tour_settings_drives_body: Add and index community drives so their art shows up in every card's picker.
tour_settings_backup_body: Create, restore and download backups of your decks, collection, history and custom art.
tour_settings_tour_body: From here you can replay the full tutorial or turn off the automatic guides.
pdf_print_scale_hint: Always print at “Actual size” / 100%, with no “Fit to page”. If cards still don't measure 63 × 88 mm, compensate your printer's scaling here.
pdf_print_scale_shared: Saved for every deck: it depends on the printer, not the deck. The 50 mm bar in the footer lets you check it.
pdf_print_actual_size: When printing, choose “Actual size” or 100% scale. “Fit to page” shrinks cards by 3-4%.
js_error_clipboard: Could not copy to the clipboard
settings_batch_wait: Wait for the batch indexing to finish.
settings_no_pinned_desc: Pin a drive with ★ to index it from here.
deck_no_phash_desc: This image has no pHash yet, so similar images cannot be searched.
deck_no_artist_desc: This art does not say who the artist is.
deck_artist_none_selected_desc: Tick at least one card to apply the art.
press_needs_cardback: Pick a card back first: every card that is not double-faced needs one.
press_intro: One card per page, each front followed by its back, in deck order, on the print shop template. The export checks every requirement before packaging.
press_guides_preview_only: The cut line and the safe area only show here. The exported PDF has no marks, as the print shop requires.
press_backs_rule: Every card gets the deck back, except double-faced cards, which get their other face.
press_backs_dfc: double-faced copies with their own back
press_export_failed: The package could not be exported
press_warn_low_resolution: low-resolution image, it may print blurry
press_warn_unusual_ratio: the image is not card-shaped and has been stretched
press_warn_rotated: horizontal image, rotated 90° to fit the page
press_warn_cmyk_untagged: CMYK image without a profile, kept as is
press_step_review: Open the PDF and check the cards and their backs page by page.
press_legend_cut: Cut line: where the shop trims the card (63×88 mm)
press_legend_safe: Safe area: keep text and symbols inside
press_legend_bleed: Bleed: printed but trimmed away (3 mm per side)
calibration_scale_intro: If printed cards measure less than 63 × 88 mm, the printer is shrinking the sheet. Print this sheet, measure both rulers and the app works out how much to enlarge the PDF to make up for it.
calibration_scale_actual_size: First print at “Actual size” / 100%, with no “Fit to page”: that is almost always enough. Only calibrate if the ruler still doesn't measure what it says.
calibration_scale_current: The sheet will be generated with your current compensation:
calibration_scale_measured_x_hint: From 0 to 150 on paper. It should measure 150 mm.
calibration_scale_measured_y_hint: From 0 to 200 on paper. It should measure 200 mm.
calibration_scale_exact: The scale is already exact: nothing to change.
calibration_scale_suspicious: A difference above 5% is rarely the printer itself: check you printed at “Actual size” and that the paper in the dialog matches the PDF (A4 vs Letter).
calibration_scale_where: Applies to every deck in PDF Studio → Print scale. Reprint the sheet to verify: it should measure exactly 150 and 200 mm.
batch_subtitle: Match your images to the deck's cards by name
batch_button_title: Give every card in the deck your own image at once, matched by name
batch_intro: Choose where the images come from. Each file goes to the card with the same name; before anything is saved you will see what goes where and can fix it.
batch_drop_title: Drop a folder, images or a ZIP here
batch_drop_hint: PNG, JPG or WEBP up to 30 MB. Subfolders are included.
batch_fit_label: If an image is not card-shaped:
batch_naming_hint: Recognised names: “Sol Ring.png”, “sol_ring.jpg”, “001 - Sol Ring.png”, “Sol Ring (Artist).png”, “Sol Ring - Anime.png” and, for the back, “Delver of Secrets [BACK].png” or the back face's name.
batch_library_desc: Use the images already in the app's custom art folder (copy them there with your file explorer) or in your linked folders.
batch_linked_desc: Link a folder on your computer to use its images without copying them. Changes there are picked up on rescan, and the app never deletes its files.
batch_settings_hint: To apply them to a deck, open the deck and press “Batch art”.
batch_link_hint: Paste the full path (in Windows Explorer: right-click the folder → “Copy as path”).
batch_folder_offline: Unavailable: disconnected drive? Its images are kept.
batch_unlink_msg: Its images will no longer show in the app. The files are not touched.
batch_unlink_in_use: {n} cards use images from this folder and will go back to their official art. The files are not touched.
batch_no_images: There are no PNG, JPG or WEBP images in what you chose.
batch_zip_only_title: Only the ZIP files are used
batch_zip_only_msg: You mixed ZIP files and loose images: the ZIP files are imported. Add the loose images in another pass.
batch_overwrite: Also replace custom art already chosen
batch_truncated: Only the first 2000 images are processed.
batch_none_matched: No image matches the name of a card in the deck. Check the “No card” tab to assign them by hand.
batch_status_keep: Has other custom art: tick it to replace it
batch_missing_hint: These cards keep their current art. Add images named after them and try again.
batch_footer_hint: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
batch_done_snapshot: A snapshot of the deck was saved before the change, and you can undo it here or from the history.
art_upload_err_bad_zip: The file is not a valid ZIP.
art_upload_err_zip_too_many_entries: The ZIP has too many files (3000 at most).
art_upload_err_zip_too_large: The unpacked ZIP is too large (4 GB at most).
art_upload_err_linked_file: This image is in a linked folder: delete it from that folder and rescan.
art_upload_err_not_a_folder: That path does not exist or is not a folder.
art_upload_err_too_broad: Choose a specific folder, not the root of a drive or your home folder.
art_upload_err_inside_app_folder: That folder is already part of the app's custom art: no need to link it.
art_upload_err_overlaps: That folder is inside another linked folder (or contains one).
art_upload_err_too_many: You have reached the maximum number of linked folders.
error_art_choice_required: Either scryfall_id or custom_art_id is required.
error_deck_no_active_cards: The deck has no active cards.
error_deck_without_resolved_cards: The deck has no resolved cards.
error_fts5_unavailable: FTS5 is not available in this SQLite build.
error_indexing_in_progress: An indexing run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
error_local_source_not_found: Source not found or not a local folder.
error_nothing_to_purge: Nothing was selected to free up.
error_phash_unavailable: pHash unavailable: install Pillow and imagehash.
error_linked_file: This art lives in a linked folder: delete it from that folder.
error_invalid_url: The URL is not valid for this site: {url}
error_invalid_image_url: That image could not be used: {reason}
error_undo_art_changed: Cannot undo: the art has changed since then.
error_undo_card_gone: Cannot undo: the card is no longer in the deck.

error_undo_custom_art: Custom art changes cannot be undone automatically.

setting_default_cardstock_desc: Preselected in the deck editor before generating the XML.
setting_foil_default_desc: Ticks the foil box when a deck is opened.
setting_default_cardback_name_desc: Looked up in the card backs folder as <name>.png/.jpg.
setting_auto_update_desc: When the app opens and there is a connection, it looks for a new version (the latest release or, when running from a git clone, origin/main) and installs it before starting. Your data is not touched.
setting_preferred_language_desc: Preselected when you press “Language ▾” in the deck editor. Scryfall only has art in the requested language if that printing exists: promos, Secret Lairs and others are English-only and are kept as they are.
setting_prefer_full_art_desc: Turns the “Full art” filter on automatically when the gallery opens.
setting_prefer_borderless_desc: Turns the “Borderless” filter on automatically when the gallery opens.
setting_usd_to_eur_desc: Applied when converting MPC prices (USD) to euros.
setting_shipping_base_eur_desc: Fixed cost of MPC international shipping.
setting_shipping_eu_extra_eur_desc: Extra for shipping within the European Union.
setting_moxfield_user_agent_desc: Should identify you with a contact. A courtesy to Moxfield.
setting_google_api_key_desc: Optional but recommended. Used to index the community Google Drives and for fuzzy art search. Free at console.cloud.google.com (APIs & Services → Credentials → API key, then enable 'Google Drive API'). Quota: 10,000 requests/day.
setting_ssl_insecure_desc: Only if your corporate network intercepts HTTPS with a CA that not even truststore recognises and you see CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED errors. Requires restarting the app. Same as the MPC_FORGE_INSECURE_SSL=1 environment variable.
setting_mpc_autofill_exe_path_desc: Path to the desktop tool binary (chilli-axe/mpc-autofill). Leave it empty and the app looks in the PATH and the project folder. Download it from github.com/chilli-axe/mpc-autofill/releases.
setting_paths_art_dir_desc: Thumbnails and art downloaded from Scryfall. It can grow to several GB with heavy use — move it to another disk if space is tight. Empty = use the default next to the executable.
setting_paths_custom_art_dir_desc: Local images that replace each card's official art. Empty = use the default next to the executable.
setting_paths_exports_dir_desc: Output files are saved here (XML for MPC Autofill, proxy PDFs). Useful to point at a shared folder if you work on several PCs. Empty = use the default next to the executable.
setting_paths_backups_dir_desc: Manual backups are compressed here. Best pointed at another disk or a cloud-synced folder (Dropbox, OneDrive). Empty = use the default next to the executable.
setting_paths_cardbacks_dir_desc: Back images available in the picker, referenced by file name from the editor. Empty = use the default next to the executable.
setting_bulk_auto_refresh_label: Keep card data up to date
setting_bulk_auto_refresh_desc: If you already imported Scryfall's data, on startup it checks whether it is more than a week old and, if Scryfall published a new file, reimports it in the background (new cards, prices and legalities). The first import is always manual.
setting_show_card_roles_desc: In the deck statistics, counts ramp, draw, removal, wipes, counters, tutors, protection and recursion from the community tags (Tagger) Scryfall publishes. Needs the card data imported.
setting_phash_enabled_desc: Computes a perceptual hash of every art to group identical images even across drives or with slight compression differences. Requires downloading the thumbnails (~50KB each). Enabling it can take several minutes the first time if you have many indexed drives. Requires Pillow and imagehash.
setting_phash_threshold_desc: Maximum Hamming distance for two images to count as 'the same'. Lower = stricter (only near-identical copies). Higher = also groups variants with crops / watermarks. Typical range: 4-12.
settings_source_placeholder_auto: URL or path (the type is detected automatically)
pdfg_flow_1: Pick a preset close to what you want to print (classic MPC, with bleed, duplex…). Fine-tune on top if needed.
pdfg_flow_2: Scroll through the preview: every sheet is drawn as it will print. The blue margins can be turned on in the top bar.
pdfg_flow_3: If something falls off the sheet, adjust the advanced positioning (X/Y offset) until it matches your printer.
pdfg_flow_4: Press Generate PDF. The file is ready to download and send to a print shop or your own printer.
pdfg_flow_5: If you want the loose images (for MPC Autofill, for example), use Export ZIP.
pdfg_page_size: A4 (210×297 mm) is the European standard. Letter (216×279 mm) for the US. A3 fits 4×3 = 12 cards per sheet.
pdfg_page_orientation: Portrait fits 3×3 cards on A4 (the classic MPC layout). Landscape is only useful on A3 or for irregular layouts.
pdfg_page_grid: Cards per sheet. Use 0 to compute it from the page size. The default 3×3 is the classic MPC layout.
pdfg_pos_gap: Space between cards. Useful for Silhouette / Cricut (they need room for the cutting sensor) or to give the guillotine some slack.
pdfg_pos_offset: Moves the WHOLE grid. Positive Y = up, positive X = right. Compensates for printers that skew the paper.
pdfg_pos_back: EXTRA shift added only to the back sheets. In duplex many printers drift 1–2 mm when flipping the paper: correct it here.
pdfg_bleed: Extends the image beyond the visible area so the guillotine leaves no white edge if it drifts. MPC asks for 1.875 mm. For home printing with manual cutting it is usually not needed.
pdfg_cguides_intro: Marks around each card that show where to cut.
pdfg_cguides_style: Corners = 4 marks, one per corner (less ink, cleaner). Full = a whole rectangle around the card.
pdfg_cguides_shape: Square = straight lines. Round = arcs that follow a card's natural rounding (~3 mm radius).
pdfg_cguides_pattern: Stroke style. Dashed and dotted use less ink and sometimes cut cleaner with a guillotine.
pdfg_cguides_place: Outside: the mark sits OUTSIDE the visible area and does not touch the art. Middle: centred on the edge. Inside: within the area, visible on the cut card; only useful for ink tests.
pdfg_cguides_look: Visual settings. Grey #606060 at 0.4 pt is the norm: invisible after cutting, visible while you cut.
pdfg_pguides_intro: Lines that cross the whole sheet, not just around each card. Useful for long guillotines.
pdfg_pguides_full: Continuous lines from edge to edge. The most help aligning the guillotine, but they cross the cards.
pdfg_pguides_corners: Only short segments in the page margins, outside the grid. They guide the guillotine without marking the inside.
pdfg_duplex: In double-sided printing you may want the guides only on the front (for cutting) and NOT on the back (so they don't show through thin paper). These toggles hide each kind of guide per side.
pdfg_regmarks: Black squares in 3 corners (TL, TR, BL) that Silhouette Cameo, Cricut and similar cutters read with their optical sensor for contour cutting. Inset = distance to the sheet edge; Size = square size. Only enable it with an automatic cutter: it is useless with a guillotine.
pdfg_backs_content: All: every slot gets a back; DFC/MDFC use their B side and the rest the standard back (or this deck's). DFC only: only transform / MDFC / meld cards get a back; the rest stay empty.
pdfg_backs_layout: At the end: all the front sheets first, then the back sheets. Ideal for SINGLE-sided printing and a guillotine. Duplex: fronts and backs interleaved, mirrored horizontally, for double-sided printing flipped on the long edge.
pdfg_backs_fill_title: Fill gaps on the last sheet
pdfg_backs_fill: Only in at the end mode. If the last front sheet has free slots (60 cards ÷ 9 per sheet leave 6 cards and 3 gaps on the last one), it fills them with the first backs before starting another sheet. Saves paper: enable it if you cut card by card.
pdfg_backs_deck: You can give this deck its own card back, independent of the global one. It applies to every non-DFC card.
pdfg_range: Syntax 1-3,5,7-9. Empty = all. Useful to reprint just the sheet that went wrong without regenerating everything.
pdfg_footer: Adds a small grey line at the bottom, like “MPC Forge · Fronts · sheet 1/6 · grid 3×3”. It only uses the margin: it never touches the cards.
pdfg_click_1: Every card in the preview is clickable: it opens a picker with all its printings so you can change the art without leaving the Studio. Double-clicking an official Scryfall art remembers it across all your decks.
pdfg_click_2: Clicking a card back opens the deck's card back picker. For advanced search (Google Drives, URLs, artist or rarity filters), use the picker's Full editor button: it opens the deck editor in a new tab.
pdfg_preset_classic: 3×3 without bleed, per-card corner guides. Home printing or a pre-MPC check.
pdfg_preset_bleed: The same layout with 1.875 mm of bleed: what MakePlayingCards asks for.
pdfg_preset_duplex: Each front sheet followed by its mirrored back sheet, for DFCs ONLY. The rest print without a back.
pdfg_preset_allbacks: The same, but with the standard back on non-DFC cards. Everything ready to fold.
pdfg_preset_silhouette: Adds a 3 mm gap between cards and registration marks for automatic cutting with Silhouette / Cricut.
pdfg_presets_note: Choosing a preset overwrites your current values for those options. Everything the preset does not touch is kept.

deck_add_card_hint: Looked up by exact name on Scryfall. Your global art preference is applied if there is one.

toolbar_next_tier: +{n} cards to the {tier} tier → total {total} € (you save {saves} €)
toolbar_preload_title: Preloading alternative art: the picker will be instant
deck_lang_note_promos: Printings that only exist in English (promos, Secret Lair…) stay as they are.
cardback_url_hint: Paste a Google Drive link or any web image. It is downloaded to your local art library and assigned.
cardback_search_placeholder: Search by name… (empty = every card back)
cardback_found: {n} card backs found in the indexed drives
cardback_no_results: No results. Try another keyword, or check that drives are indexed in
cardback_none_in_drives: No card backs in the indexed drives. Check that there are drives with Cardbacks/ folders in
cardback_no_local: You have no custom art. Add one with the form above or drop a file in the custom_art/ folder of your data.
pdf_grid_hint: The default 3×3 is the classic MPC layout. Lower it if you want more margin.
pdf_back_offset_hint: Shift applied only to the back sheets, to compensate for printer drift when the paper is flipped.
pdf_page_guides_hint: Full-page lines (for a guillotine or rotary trimmer). Same colour and width as the per-card guides.
pdf_duplex_guides_hint: Hide the guides on the fronts or on the backs: useful if you only cut one side.
pdf_bleed_hint: MPC uses 1.875 mm. For home printers 1 mm is usually enough.
pdf_reg_marks_hint: Black squares in 3 corners for Silhouette Cameo / Cricut.
pdf_backs_all_hint: DFC → B side · rest → standard card back
pdf_backs_duplex_hint: Fronts and backs interleaved with a horizontal mirror: print double-sided, flipping on the long edge.
pdf_backs_append_hint: All back sheets go at the end of the PDF.
pdf_backs_fill_hint: Fills the free slots on the last front sheet with the first backs before starting a new sheet. Saves paper when cutting card by card.
pdf_deck_cardback_hint: Applied to every card except DFC / MDFC / meld, which use their own back face.
